asked QD3-001: D3a-01, two questions on reading and writing at D3's scale. The ledger holds 42,243 lines: 26,206 other than absent, 14,608 absent lines that mark evidence limits, 67 evidenced absences, 1,362 propose. (1) Reading: mem.py adaptations --element shows each line with how clipped at 90 characters and without condition, statement, observation, relation or transitions, so a packet read through it is not read whole (J, 11 October). May I read each packet of at most 100 lines through a read-only helper (out/_analysis/d3_packet.py) that selects exactly what the verb selects (one element, sorted by op and room) and prints every field whole, with each cited concept's label from the store, the room's repairs from REPAIRS.tsv, and whether the room's placements carry the element? It never reads the ledger beyond one element's packet. (2) Writing: mem.py adjudicate appends one line per call, re-reads the whole ledger each time (0.3 s) and writes one diary note per line, so the census means 42,243 calls and 42,243 diary notes. May I rule restrict, contradict, add-condition, add-step, link, evidenced absent, the field's entries and propose lines one by one through the verb, and write instantiate and evidence-limit absent lines per packet from a rulings file through a helper (out/_analysis/d3_adjudicate_batch.py) that makes the verb's own checks (id in the ledger, a known decision, a reason, pair in the ledger) and appends the verb's exact line format, with one diary note per packet naming the ids and the counts by decision, as J allowed batch writers at B1? | meanwhile: Until the answer comes I read through mem.py adaptations, mem.py theme, mem.py codes and cite.py, and write every ruling through mem.py adjudicate, one call per line. This leg takes one element group, R01 (709 lines).

D3 ruling rules, written before any line is ruled (they hold for every element group; SCHEMA sections 2, 4 and 6; stage D3 sections 1 and 2; J 12:59 on absent lines). G1 instantiate: accept (specification) when the source theme and the cited concepts show the element as stated, inside its range; the element is the shared construct, so no pair is needed. Modify when the how claims more than the concepts show, with a revised sentence inside the evidence. Reject when the concepts show something else, named in the reason. G2 absent marking an evidence limit (unobserved, not-testable): accept with kind evidence-limit, counted apart and never as specification or correction, when the line gives a reason the record cannot show the element; where the room's placements carry the element, I read the cited concepts first and reject the line if they show the element. G3 absent evidenced (observed-absent, not-needed): accept as specification when the cited concepts show the absence or the lack of need; otherwise accept with kind evidence-limit (a reclassification). G4 elaborations (add-condition, add-step, link) and G5 corrections (restrict, contradict): accept with pair when a second room's supported line meets the same target at the same lifted third- or fourth-order node; otherwise particular when the evidence suffices, pending when it does not. Two accepted corrections meeting so trigger the element's re-examination in the same leg, with a written warrant; the count never chooses the revision. G6 a line naming the room itself in its condition or failing portability is a particular (SCHEMA section 4, rule 5); a room named in relation is not. G7 where REPAIRS.tsv bears on a pattern of rulings, repaired and unrepaired rooms are compared. G8 every reason names its evidence: the concepts or the source theme.

D3a-01, element group 1 opened: R01, the starter (role; tiers T3-033, T3-092; dimension D02; standing; the arrow A02 runs from it to P01). 709 lines in 699 rooms: instantiate 579, absent 107 (all evidence limits; 0 evidenced), restrict 17, add-step 3, add-condition 3. Findings touching it: F-017 (goals proposed by one member in 166 rooms). Read through mem.py adaptations in packets of at most 100 lines, by op; QD3-001 asks for a whole-line reader and a batch writer, and until it is answered every line is ruled through mem.py adjudicate.

D3 ruling rules amended before any line is ruled. (a) G2 and G3: the stage check admits only specification, elaboration, correction, proposal, particular and none as an adjudication's kind, so a line ruled as an evidence limit (an absent line marked unobserved or not-testable, or any line whose content records only what the record cannot show) is accepted with kind none and a reason that says so; kind none is how such lines are counted apart, never as specification or correction (J, 12:59). (b) G4 and G5: a line is paired with a second room's line that makes the same correction or elaboration of the same element in substance, named in the reason, whatever its lifted node (SCHEMA section 6: the same candidate correction); a meeting at the same third- or fourth-order node remains the trigger of section 2 and only that. (c) A line ingest marked portable false is a particular, or a modify whose revised text is portable; it is never accepted as it stands.
